202.instructions: Complete TotalsByCustomer so it returns one CustomerTotal per customer, ordered by total descending, then by customer name ascending. Ignore Cancelled orders; totals are decimal.

solution.code:
public static IReadOnlyList<CustomerTotal> TotalsByCustomer(IEnumerable<Order> orders) =>
    orders.Where(o => o.Status != OrderStatus.Cancelled)
          .GroupBy(o => o.Customer)
          .Select(g => new CustomerTotal(g.Key, g.Sum(o => o.Total)))
          .OrderByDescending(t => t.Total).ThenBy(t => t.Customer)
          .ToList();
